notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Castlevania: Belmont's Curse" (checked twice). castlevania.fandom.com answers the API under the same title, with about 103 linked pages, including "Arcana", "Tarot Cards", "Leon Belmont/Belmont's Curse" and "Brauner (Belmont's Curse)"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 4231820 is "Castlevania: Belmont's Curse"; the schema uses the same name. 17 of 29 Steam achievements are hidden; their names suggest bosses and story beats, but all sit in the story chapter because their conditions are secret. RAWG has no playtime or tags yet (released 2026-10-15).
